newsitem.title: USA: USDA EXPANDS FLORIDA MEDFLY QUARANTINE.
newsitem.headline: USDA EXPANDS FLORIDA MEDFLY QUARANTINE.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday it was adding parts of Hillsborough and Orange counties to areas under quarantine in Florida to prevent the spread of the destructive Mediterranean fruit fly.

USDA's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service also revised the quarantine boundaries for Manatee County, Fla. It said the changes were effective Aug 7 and will be published in the Federal Register Aug 13.
The Mediterranean fruit fly is one of the world's most destructive agricultural pests, attacking more than 250 different fruits and vegetables. It can halve crop yields.
